rows.en: ＠２１０＿０１３＊Narusawa＊Welcome to Station Alpha.＝＠２１０＿０１４Let's start with introductions.
＠２１０＿０１５＊Narusawa＊My name is Kazuya Narusawa.￥I'm the director in charge of￥this project.
＊Sakaki＊＠２１０＿０１６I'm Yuri Sakaki. I'll also be￥overseeing all of you.＝＠２１０＿０１７Nice to meet you, everyone.
＠２１０＿０１８＊Narusawa＊Normally, this is where some￥bigwig would give a speech on￥behalf of all humanity, but...

＠２１０＿０１９＊Narusawa＊Only a handful of people even￥know this project exists. It's￥strictly top secret.＝＠２１０＿０２０Until it's over, contact with￥anyone outside family and staff￥is strictly forbidden.＝＠２１０＿０２１And even if you get homesick,￥you won't be allowed to go home.
＠２１０＿０２２＊Sakaki＊This is partly about secrecy,￥and partly to keep you safe from￥things like terrorism.＝＠２１０＿０２３We're counting on your￥cooperation.

＠２１０＿０２４＊Narusawa＊Long ago... back when Earth was￥still blue, humanity built this￥place as a deep-space outpost.＝＠２１０＿０２５Faraway Elan... If you ask me,￥it's the perfect stepping stone￥for humanity's new beginning.
＠２１０＿０２６＊Narusawa＊Honestly, this thing belongs in￥a museum. So forgive the￥occasional inconvenience.
＠２１０＿０２７＊Sakaki＊The starship comes first, so we￥haven't had much time to spare￥for this place.＝＠２１０＿０２８Sorry about that.
＠２１０＿０２９＊Narusawa＊Now then. Here on Alpha, you'll￥spend a while honing your￥abilities.＝＠２１０＿０３０Each subject has its own room,￥fully set up with the training￥equipment you'll need.
＠２１０＿０３１＊Narusawa＊There's no fixed schedule.￥Do things your own way.
＠２１０＿０３２＊Sakaki＊Your self-discipline and￥teamwork will also count toward￥whether you qualify.＝＠２１１＿００１Keep that in mind.
